content: Pawl nag ma̱wana tasiyas takatidavidavs
Yey alivan ma̱wana takabala̱wein yey. Awoum bikawegweis woumiy, mo bakamtel nanoug.
Yey apwa̱kit wasigeis yakamiy ma̱wan Yowbad ipwa̱kit wasigeis yakamiy. Bo abokeimiy simiy Kelis mamagina vin naptabod binek namwan anmwa̱net. Sivinag ma̱wan batokeimiy bukunekes Kelis.
Tage agupwa̱yat Seitan, peinan kweiboug mamagina mwatet ansinap tawtoun ikatidev Iv. Adok yakamiy ma̱wan igaw bikatidaveimiy mo bukupiyaves tapwa̱loul kamnat waseg Kelis.

Nakageiguy liva̱nen Yeisuw. Tage igaw kal beiw bigeiguy tobwag Yeisuw, o tobwag kululuwan biwekeimiy, o livan towen bwanabwein nukuliganes kukin bukupiyaves, mo bukutams tobwag livan waseg. E, bo kutams waseg, mwasanin yakamiy.
Takaweins livan towen, kudokes singay bwein gamag; tage nag bilaveigs yey.
Kukin nag balivan tawtoun, tage agusinap tawtoun. Youd babaw bo akatimlakeimiy ikous.
Kweiboug sigwey yakamiy nasekeimiy bwanabwein liva̱nen Yowbad. Nag kweitan muloul akow. Yey a̱bus va̱gan bayamweneimiy. Tabta agusinap towen kalbaleb, ne?
Mamagina nitavenos simoney tasiyas ven mwasanin tayakelesiys, peinan bo akow simuloul wasipalatan va̱gan bawotet yakamiy wamipalatan.

E, igaw kweiboug sigwey yakamiy nitasesus mo ika̱bwag gunwuliyoug, nag anitoug wasigeis yakamiy. Sidayas gog min-Masidoniy nimeis mo isekeigs. Mapuna nag anitoug. Nag kweitan mumuloul avag va̱gan bimouvit wasigeis yakamiy, nag. Igaw nag bavag, nag.
Agulivan tawtoun towen. Nag teitan bisilbwed agulivan towen ven Akay waseg. Tabudabod Kelis.
Wawun nalivan ma̱wan, peinan singay asiwyoubumiy. Yowbad ikakin.
Gunawotet ma̱wan, waseg bavvalut ee... mo babob asilivan tasiyas nikaya̱pams peinan idokes siwotet ma̱wana yakamey.
Tasiyas idokes tatineis takaweins liva̱nen Kelis. Tayyaweids gog. Siwotet waseg ikatidavis gamag, peinan askakin ma̱wana takaweins liva̱nen Kelis.
Magen! Seitan-vak ivag ankakin ma̱wana gum-liba̱lab, kamnat waseg.
Igagaba natouwat tasiyas biva̱ges askakin ma̱wan takaweins sinap didumwal. Sikabiyokous kalbaleb, peinan siwotet kalbaleb.
Tut babaw a̱ban igeg Pawl
Vayuwein alana, “Awoum kudokeigs takabala̱wein yey.” Tage bukudokeigs takabala̱wein, kadiloka balivan kakit ma̱wana tasiyas takabala̱weins, mo kuliganes agulivan.
DaGuyaws nag ikaluweg agulivan va̱gan bakaypom sinap, tage bakaypom ma̱wana takabala̱wein yey, ma̱wana tasiyas ikaypamwes sinapun ven watinow.
Yakamiy kutams bwein wasigeis tasiyas takabala̱weins, peinan adok amisinap tawtoun yakamiy!

Bukutams bwein, kukin kalisiy bikaweimiy binaweimiy silma̱nin siwotet bukuwteles, o kukin bikwekways mivavag o bisilkodeimiy, o bikaypamwes asisinap, mo beiweiys mitamiy. E, mo bukutams waseg mituwa̱vek tasiyas.
Nag ivag guntawtoun silma̱nin wotet ma̱wana tasiyas. Mapuna agumwasin ivag. Kukin kal bitawtoun mo bikaypom; o yey-vak kukin batawtoun bakaypom mo bamlavag takabala̱wein yey. Tage bo bakaypom.
Adok tasiyas min-Ibliw. Yey ma̱wan. Adok tasiyas min-Yisleil. Yey ma̱wan. Adok tasiyas Ebelam delen. Yey bo ma̱wan.
Adok tasiyas Kelis natouwats. Bo alisawes tasiyas. (Agulivan ma̱wana takabala̱wein.) Yey alisawes wotet waseg, o deil waseg; peinan tuta babaw gamag niwaweigs, kakita bakanig.
Siva̱nim min-Yudiy iyousigs mo iwaweigs vatul waseg. Vatul waseg biwaweigs babewein sinawatoun kweinim kweivas.
Siva̱toun iyousigs mo iwaweigs amweilok waseg. Sivtanok dakul ikawes, ilivelovs, imimekeig, iwaweigs. Siva̱toun amukul wa̱wag. Siva̱tan iyatuwaneig wakunuwatan yol katanok yam katanok boug.

Tut babaw atita̱vin, alouvat youd kalbaleb nisesus wa̱lay. Wa̱ked-vak tavveinaws tawa̱yins gamag nisesus. Agugwamag sivines kid beiweigs; tobwag ven gimgilis sivines kid beiweigs. Sivines kid beiweigs waven o wanawoud o wabwanit. Sidayas tasiyas tayyaweids beiweigs kid.
Gunawotet waseg son agupulikas, sona moumouvit; nag amasis ibwein, agumoun, agudak, tut babaw ikamateig moun, son aguloulun amasis wamnat.
Sona youd tasiyas yam katanok katanok ikubukub nuwag waseg imouvit gunawotet wasigeis tayakelesiys vena babaw.
Kukin kal beigwey mo bigeg nanoug; o kal bikalouw mo bikapasal nuwag peinan youd towen ivakaben.
Kukin balivan, peinan va̱gan bukukwakins ama̱wan tougwey yey.
Awoum bayaweid. DaYowbads, daGuyaws Yeisuw taman, ikakin agusinap mounid. Kalin nuwads Yeisuw tut nag beikous.

Ven Damasik waseg, tutan Aletas king ven towen waseg, Tanuwagan ven inagamag ikaymates awkwedan ven, sivines kid biyousigs. Tage taliwog ikaliyowes sinta̱boul ven boul-nen waseg, yey asin wanuwan kaynad, ikaygwagweigs ee... an aton watinow, anoun, mo alisow towen nikamliweig.
